title: Full affine etale restriction is an equivalence for Type (u + 1)
statement:
theorem fullAffineEtale_large_sets_equivalence (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    ((fullAffineEtaleInclusion S).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
      (fullAffineEtaleTopology S) S.smallEtaleTopology).IsEquivalence

proof.text: Identify the Grothendieck topology generated by smallEtalePretopology.toPrecoverage with smallEtaleTopology. The first equality follows by the universal property of generated topology and the covering-presieve characterization of Pretopology.toGrothendieck; the second is Mathlib Scheme.smallGrothendieckTopology_eq_toGrothendieck_smallPretopology.

Use the first conjunct of fullAffineEtale_special_cocontinuity to obtain cocontinuity. For each etale object, its last conjunct gives a covering presieve by affine image objects. Its generated sieve is contained in Sieve.coverByImage; upward closure gives IsCoverDense.

The inclusion is full and faithful by ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory. If the image of a sieve covers, cocontinuity makes its functor pullback cover; the full-faithful pushforward-pullback identity recovers the original sieve. Conversely continuity gives CoverPreserving.of_isContinuous. These facts construct Functor.IsDenseSubsite.

Apply Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.DenseSubsite.SheafEquiv: the instance Functor.IsDenseSubsite.instIsEquivalenceSheafSheafPushforwardContinuous supplies the desired equivalence for Type (u+1). The required limits of StructuredArrow diagrams in Type (u+1) are available by typeclass inference; no resizing or new proof obligation is used.

proof_origin.note: Proof from existing special cocontinuity and continuity; generic dense-subsite comparison realizes the same affine-cover argument at the larger coefficient universe. No new holes.
